etymologies.etymologyHTML: From creative +‎ -ity.

definitions.definition: The ability to use imagination to produce a novel idea or product.

quote.citation: 2012 June 9, Owen Phillips, “Euro 2012: Netherlands 0 – 1 Denmark”, in BBC Sport‎[1], archived from the original on 4 November 2016:
quote.text: Netherlands, one of the pre-tournament favourites, combined their undoubted guile, creativity, pace and attacking quality with midfield grit and organisation.
